known_instructions: The panel asked for a short recommendation and tradeoff summary.
No external research may be used during the exercise.
assumptions: The audience wants concise bullets rather than a long narrative.
The decision criteria will stay within the prompt.

problem: Restate the prompt and define the decision in one sentence.
evidence: Use only verified facts from the private profile and the prompt.
options: Compare two or three feasible options with clear tradeoffs.
recommendation: Pick the best option and say why it wins.
risks: State the main assumptions and where the answer could break.
next_steps: Close with the next check or action you would take.

evidence: Led a 14-month Oracle cloud migration for 1,000 critical workloads.
Managed cross-functional stakeholders across a complex program.

segments: 5 minutes: restate the prompt and success criteria.
20 minutes: outline the answer and pressure-test assumptions.
20 minutes: time a full rehearsal and tighten the close.

technical_checks: Check camera, microphone and screen sharing.
Open any allowed materials before the start time.
Confirm the timer and note-taking setup.
logistics_checks: Confirm the start time and time zone.
Use a quiet room and a stable connection.

conditions: No calculator unless the instructions explicitly allow it
guidance: Manage pace and skip only if the instructions permit it.
Request accommodations before the assessment starts.

risks: Over-explaining could crowd out the recommendation.
A missing logistics check could waste timed minutes.
next_steps: Verify the assessment platform and any accommodation request path.
